stored_taxon_descriptor.notes: Gram-positive, moderately thermophilic (optimum 45-50°C), facultatively autotrophic bacterium that oxidizes both ferrous iron and reduced sulfur compounds. Spore-forming capability provides resilience to environmental stress, toxic metals, and nutrient limitation. Grows mixotrophically on organic compounds plus Fe²⁺ or S⁰, bridging autotrophic and heterotrophic niches. Sulfobacillus was one of the dominant bacterial groups in 2023 bio-oxidation reactors and the related S. acidophilus rather than A. caldus predominated in the middle stage of the adapted chalcopyrite culture. Enhanced ferrous iron oxidation capacity maintains Fe³⁺ supply for chalcopyrite dissolution during these transitions. Metal tolerance enables activity in copper, zinc, and nickel-rich leachates. Sulfobacillus species are critical for industrial thermophilic bioleaching (50-60°C) where elevated temperatures from exothermic sulfide oxidation favor this organism over mesophilic Acidithiobacillus.
